errors.text_span: 水平轴列出了四个语体：新闻、科技文献、网络小说和微博
errors.evidence: Figure (a) and (b) have categorical x-axes with labels such as 前端/尾端/前均值 (as shown in the image and reference), not four语体 categories. The machine description misidentifies the x-axis categories.
The y-axis label in the figure is 频次, not 数量.
The description does not identify the two-panel figure as showing the distribution of second-level semantic domains across categories in subfigures (a) and (b), as indicated by the caption/reference.

errors.text_span: 耳目较暗表示与生活/工作相关的动词，而较浅的颜色则表示与生理活动相关的动词
errors.evidence: The legend contains many more than two semantic-domain categories, with multiple colors mapped to distinct labels; the description collapses them into only two groups and assigns the color mapping incorrectly/overly simplistically.

errors.text_span: 在新闻语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 5700，与生理活动相关的大柱子则约为 2700。在科技文献语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 3300，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 1500。在网络小说语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 2200，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 1000。在微博语体中，与生活/工作相关的大柱子高度约为 1500，而与生理活动相关的大柱子高度约为 800。
errors.evidence: These categories and values do not correspond to the figure. The chart shows different category labels and stacked totals around values such as 4356, 5636, 586 in (a) and 5714 in (b), not the four social-media/news genres and the cited heights.

errors.text_span: 新闻语体中“与生活/工作相关”的比例为 88%， “与生理活动相关”的比例为 12%
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain these语体-specific percentages; the visible percentages in the stacked bars are different (e.g., 53%, 92%, 57% in the reference/figure), and the cited 88%/12% values are not shown.

errors.text_span: 每个语体的动词根据其二级语义域进行分组，并以堆叠柱状图的形式呈现。
errors.evidence: Although the figure uses stacked bars, it is not organized by four语体 categories as claimed. The structure is a two-panel comparison with categorical labels on the x-axis, not separate bars for news/technology/novel/weibo.

errors.text_span: 新闻语体的柱状图明显比其他语体的柱状图更高，值也更大。
errors.evidence: This is an interpretive comparison not explicitly stated by the figure and is based on the incorrect premise of four语体 categories.
